notes: Two taḥwīl branches (وكيع; أبو معاوية) meet at الأعمش: «كلاهما عن الأعمش» is written once and belongs to both (rule 3). The two Abu Razin / Abu Salih are co-transmitters on one level.
«وفي حديث وكيع قال يرفعه بمثله» is a wording and attribution remark about a man already in the chain: left out.
